build_aim_model: build an AIM vision transformer model using aim_600M, aim_1B, aim_3B, or aim_7B factory functions
load_aim_model_from_url: load a pretrained AIM model from HuggingFace using __model_loader__ with a model name and device
create_vit_preprocessor: create a ViTPreprocessor module with PatchEmbed, sinusoidal or absolute positional embeddings, and optional cls token
create_transformer_trunk: create a Transformer trunk with configurable attention heads, MLP blocks, LayerNorm, and an AverageLayers post-transformer probe
run_aim_forward_pass: run a forward pass through an AIM model to get global, per-token, and spatial patch features from an input image tensor
